models_evaluated: Kalman filter visual field prediction model (PKF)

links.outcome: Predictive accuracy of previously trained model on local real-world UK historical data versus LR and locally trained model
links.effect: PKF MD within 2.5 dB at 60 months 75.7%, better than LR models (P<.01) and similar to UK-KF (75.2%, P=.70).
links.quote: The predictive accuracy for MD within 2.5 dB of the observed value at 60 months' follow-up for PKF (75.7%) was substantially better than those for the LR models (P < .01 for both) and similar to that for UK-KF (75.2%, P = .70).

links.outcome: Comparison of the AI model against conventional linear regression standard on same data
links.effect: PKF 75.7% within 2.5 dB at 60 months vs LR models substantially lower (P<.01); 95% repeatability interval proportion 67.9% vs 40.2% and 40.9%.
links.quote: The proportion of MD predictions in the 95% repeatability intervals at 60 months' follow-up for PKF (67.9%) was higher than those for the LR models (40.2%, 40.9%) and similar to that for UK-KF (71.4%).

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation of a machine learning-based Kalman filter model to predict glaucoma visual field progression using real-world multicenter clinical data.
